text:
Vincent Schaefer's 1947 patent "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" was most likely issued jointly with Bernard Vonnegut, his General Electric colleague on the cloud-seeding work. The team note offers two candidates, Irving Langmuir and Bernard Vonnegut. I'm picking Vonnegut because the patent is a lab instrument and Vonnegut was Schaefer's direct co-inventor, but I haven't verified this against the patent record.

CONFIDENCE: 62
